note: Both sets capture the core facts (finished floor 2' - 9 1/2" above grade 0' - 0", room contents of the Centre Module and Living Room sections, 3/8" = 1'-0" scales), and both repeat the same unsupported value 2' - 3 1/2" for the Living Room finished floor, which the page never states. Set A adds several misbound or unsupported claims: CENTRE MODULE located at grid 'K', Mechanical Room located in 'Building Section A302' (A-302 is the sheet number, not a section), plus trivial duplicates such as 'WEST MODULE location West' and generic 'building section contains room' entries. Set B keeps conditions and bindings tighter (Mechanical Room within Centre Module, section scales tied to markers A1/C1) and its only clear error is the 2' - 3 1/2" value. Overall B is the more faithful and less padded set.
